[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] wielded this [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] during her time as a Jedi Knight and possessed it after she was made a Jedi Master and eventually a member on the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], wielding it on many battlefronts, including [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]] in the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]] in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]] and the galaxy-wide conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] until her murder by Savage Opress on Florrum in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].

==History==
===Last days of peace===
After losing her [[Adi Gallia's first lightsaber/Legends|first lightsaber]] in the line of duty, Gallia created a second, specialized [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="TPM Expanded Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

[[File:AdiGalliaFirstLightsaber.png|thumb|left|200px|Gallia's red blade]]
Gallia wielded her [[Color/Legends|red]]-bladed lightsaber on [[Yitheeth]] while on a [[Ambush on Yitheeth|mission]] with [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]]: the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] stopped the criminal [[Olmar Grahrk]], who was trying to start a [[Yinchorri Uprising|war]] between the [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Vilmarh Grahrk]], Olmar Grahrk's cousin, later claimed to fellow criminals that the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], including Adi Gallia, had subsequently used their lightsabers to try to arrest him because he had stolen an important [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi artifact]], but that he had been able to convince the Jedi to set him free by promising to return the treasure.<ref name="SW 41" />

Gallia used an azure-bladed lightsaber to defend Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] from an [[Attack on Supreme Chancellor Valorum|assassination attempt]] by the [[Nebula Front]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]],<ref name="COD" /> and her weapon displayed an alternatively red<ref name="Jedi Power Battles" /> or blue blade by the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="Obi-Wan">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan (video game)|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'']]</ref> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

===Clone Wars===
[[File:AdiAnakin.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Gallia and Skywalker defend themselves against commando droids.]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the lightsaber's crystal was azure blue and would remain that color. Gallia wielded the blue lightsaber above [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] when the Republic attempted to save Master Eeth Koth from [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. After Koth was rescued, she [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|crossed blades]] with the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] General without being [[Death/Legends|killed]], meaning she was one of the few to survive an encounter with him.<ref name="GI">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref> She later dueled Grievous aboard her flagship, but was captured, with Grievous claiming her lightsaber as a trophy. Gallia was soon rescued by Jedi Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and his Wolfpack squad, and she recovered her saber from the cyborg.<ref name="Nomad Droids">{{TCW|Nomad Droids}}</ref>

Master Gallia would later wield the weapon alongside fellow Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] when the two battled the two [[Brother/Legends|brothers]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], but she was no match for the sheer brute strength of Savage Opress, who gored her with his horns before killing the Jedi Master with his lightsaber. Later, Master Kenobi used Gallia's lightsaber to confront the brothers, wielding it in conjunction with his own, where he managed to partially avenge its murdered owner by using the weapon to [[Cho mok/Legends|cut off]] Opress's left [[Limb/Legends|arm]].<ref name="Revival" />
